newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: U.S. official to meet Serbian opposition in Geneva.
newsitem.headline: U.S. official to meet Serbian opposition in Geneva.

text.p: U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for European Affairs John Kornblum will meet Serbian opposition leaders in Geneva on Sunday, a U.S. spokesman said.
Kornblum will meet members of the Zajedno movement, the coalition opposed to President Slobodan Milosevic.
"Kornblum will be meeting with Serb opposition leaders at mutual request," the spokesman said.
Kornblum was expected to make a brief statement after the private talks, which will start at 1600 GMT.

The meeting comes amid mounting concern in Washington over Belgrade's handling of large demonstrations sparked by the annulling last month of the results of local election results that opposition politicians had won.
Kornblum is in Geneva to take part in a meeting on Monday on refugees and other humanitarian issues in Bosnia.
Sadako Ogata, U.N. High Commisioner for Refugees, will chair the one-day talks, which will also be attended by Carl Bildt, the international high representative for Bosnia.
